notes: Vodalian Arcanist: '{T}: Add {C}. Spend this mana only to cast an instant or sorcery spell.' Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The pool's {U} pays Frantic Inventory's {U}, and its {1} can only come from the Arcanist, whose {C} may pay an instant: the Arcanist taps and Inventory draws one card (none of its name in the graveyard). Its refusal for a creature spell is vodalian_arcanist_2.json.
